fields.summary_ko.0: Under new CEO Greg Abel, Berkshire Hathaway accelerated share buybacks, repurchasing $9.6B in Q3 and an additional $2B in October (cash decreased to $356.9B).
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 net income fell 28% to $22.11B due to underperformance in insurance operations, but achieved cumulative 5%+ outperformance versus S&P 500 through 2026.
